newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Escudo little changed on mark, low volatility seen.
newsitem.headline: Escudo little changed on mark, low volatility seen.

text.p: The escudo was trading a shade weaker against the mark on Monday but in thin volume, with the currency seen experiencing low volatility throughout the session.
The currency was trading at 100.90/93 to the mark against its 100.85/88 close on Friday. Traders saw a likely range of 100.80-101.00 for Monday.
"There is support at the figure (101.00) and there is little interest in seeking to break it unless the dollar suddenly weakens," said one trader.
